ValidationRule.description: Prevents updates to PHOCS Violation records when Status is Resolved, unless the user has the EHIS Bypass Validation Rule custom permission or the Status is changed due to Inspection retraction.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSRegulatoryCodeViolation", NOT(ISNEW()), NOT($Permission.EHISBypassValidationRuleCustomPermission), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Resolved"), NOT(ISCHANGED(Status)), NOT(ISCHANGED(DateResolved)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Violation record cannot be edited once the status is marked as Resolved
